jobs.name: tuck
jobs.prompt: 1930s rubberhose cartoon in the Fleischer Studios and Steamboat Willie tradition. Crisp, bold, confident black ink linework with flat pure-white fills. Strictly two inks, black and white: no grey tones, no shading, no gradients, no halftone, no texture. The entire background is one flat, solid, perfectly uniform bright green (#00FF00) with nothing else on it: no ground line, no ground shadow, no cast shadows, no motion lines, no dust puffs, no text, no letters, no labels, no numbers, no border, no frame, no watermark. Nothing in the drawing itself is green. The attached reference image shows an existing character from this cartoon world, on the same green background. Match its ink style, line weight, fur rendering and eye style exactly, but draw the new character described here, not the one in the reference. Do not draw a bindle or a stick. The character is a 'hobit': a small soot-sprite hobo creature from the same world as the reference character, but clearly a different individual. Face: two large white oval eyes, each with a round black pupil carrying one tiny white highlight; the two eyes sit side by side with a clear gap between them; no mouth, no nose, no eyebrows. Limbs: thin simple black rubber-hose arms and legs with no elbows or knees, round white cartoon gloves, small rounded black shoes. Body: a dense, solid-black shaggy fur ball with an irregular pointed fur silhouette and a few longer tufts on top. He is round and stout. His signature is a battered white bowler hat with a black hat band and one stitched patch, worn tilted on top of his fur. He carries nothing. A character pose sheet showing this SAME character eight times in a tidy grid of four columns and two rows, evenly spaced with generous empty green space between poses, every pose fully visible, nothing overlapping, nothing cropped, all eight drawn at exactly the same scale with identical proportions, identical outfit, identical eyes. Arms and legs never touch the body or each other in a way that closes a loop. Top row, left to right: (1) standing facing the viewer, arms relaxed and slightly away from the sides, neutral, looking straight ahead; (2) standing facing the viewer, one arm raised high waving hello; (3) startled, jumping straight up, eyes wide, arms and legs flung out; (4) sitting on the ground facing the viewer, dozing, eyes closed as two small downward curves, slumped and relaxed. Bottom row, left to right, all four in side view, facing and moving toward the right: (5) mid-walk, front leg stretched forward and back leg stretched behind; (6) mid-walk, both legs together directly under the body, body slightly higher; (7) mid-walk, legs apart again with the opposite leg forward; (8) a frantic cartoon run toward the right, body leaning far forward, legs stretched wide apart in mid-stride, arms pumping.
